description: This file defines the class LoggerPropertySetter, a utility for setting properties on objects in the log4php logging framework. It includes methods for setting individual properties by invoking setters, and for bulk setting properties based on an array of key-value pairs with optional prefix filtering.

classes.name: LoggerPropertySetter
classes.description: A class providing methods to set properties on an object, either individually or in bulk, using reflection to call setter methods based on property names. It also supports activating the object after configuration if needed.

methods.name: LoggerPropertySetter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the property setter with a target object.

methods.name: setPropertiesByObject
methods.description: Static method that sets multiple properties on an object using an associative array and a prefix filter.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets properties on the target object based on the provided array, filtering by prefix, and invoking setters accordingly.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a single property on the target object by calling its setter method if it exists, with type conversions handled for common types, and logs warnings if no setter exists.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the object if it has an 'activateoptions' method, allowing post-configuration initialization.
